purpose: Real Zed acceptance and undo checks; protocol regressions live in editor_completion.rs.
indexing: Open tools.bend and other.bend in Zed before main.bend. Wait for document symbols for both; no whole-project discovery is expected.

scenarios.name: browse, distinguish, cancel
scenarios.actions: At the final value in main.bend, open regular completion. Inspect both value candidates, browse, then press Escape.
scenarios.expect: Both source modules are visible. In-scope value_local ranks before out-of-scope candidates. No import or buffer modification occurs.

scenarios.name: accept, collide, navigate, undo
scenarios.actions: Reopen completion at final value and accept the tools.bend candidate. Navigate from the inserted value, return to main.bend, then undo once.
scenarios.expect: Definition opens tools.bend. One undo restores the exact original main.bend, removing both qualification and inserted import. Redo restores accepted_main.

scenarios.name: existing unsaved alias and repeat acceptance
scenarios.actions: Accept tools.bend value. Change Kit to Unsaved in the buffer without saving. On a new indented line type val and accept tools.bend value again.
scenarios.accepted_main:
import tools.bend as Unsaved
def main:
  Unsaved.value
  Unsaved.value
scenarios.expect: Each acceptance uses the current alias. The existing import spelling stays unchanged, and no duplicate import appears. Undo the second acceptance as one operation.

scenarios.name: unsaved target and UTF-16 middle-token replacement
scenarios.actions: Replace tools.bend with unsaved_tools without saving. In main.bend place the cursor after nw but before zz, open completion, and accept tools.bend newest.
scenarios.expect: The current unsaved symbol is offered. The old zz suffix disappears, emoji and call suffix survive, and one undo restores unsaved_main.
